title: 'Voice of God' microwave hearing program
summary: Eric Hazeline tells of 'Voice of God' microwave hearing program, about unspecified at unspecified, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
create vibrations like sound. And in
fact there's a program to modulate that
with voice. We call it the voice of God
the most crude of which you could call like the voice to skull technology I never saw that on the inside I know a different term but that's the public one
tellings.difference: Brown calls it by the public name 'voice to skull', says he never saw it himself and knows a different inside term, and calls it the crudest of a set of such technologies.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe a government program that uses microwave hearing to put voice into a person's head. Brown's 'voice to skull' and Hazeline's 'Voice of God' modulated-voice program are the same technology claim.

as_told.title: Voice-to-skull technology known under another inside term
